answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 153834 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Can a male person use umbrella over head with Ihram for Hajj/Umrah? Question: Can a male person use umbrella over head with Ihram for Hajj/Umrah? Answer ID: 153834 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1253/1171/SD=11/1438) Yes, it is lawful to use umbrella while being in ihram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
